to provide vehicle title loans. The business

BUSINESS STRATEGIES
1. Maximize Profitability Through 
Cost Efficiency
Continue driving margin improvements through 
rigorous operational cost control and optimal 
funding structures.
2. Maintain High Loan Portfolio Quality
Utilize advanced data tools for credit screening and debt 
collection to mitigate risk, reduce NPA losses, and 
maintain appropriate provisioning levels.
3. Shift to High-Yield Loan Products
Strategically adjust the portfolio to focus on high-
yield, flexible offerings, particularly driving the 
expansion of Title Loans.
4. Accelerate Digital Transformation
Fully launch e-KYC and the Mobile Lending Platform 
commercially in 2026 to streamline customer onboarding, 
extend customer outreach, and elevate customer data 
management.
6. Sustainable Growth & 
Responsible Lending
Ensure long-term business resilience and 
stakeholder trust by firmly embedding responsible 
lending practices into our core operations.
9
5. Proactive Compliance & 
Grassroots Partnership
Rigorously align with the 2026 regulatory 
frameworks and serve as a trusted financial 
partner to the grassroots population.



--- Page 10 ---
BRANCH NETWORK
Strategy 
•
Maintain current branch network scale
•
Leverage technology to reach customers beyond branch 
locations (e.g., “mobile branch” model)
• As of December 2025, SAWAD Group operates a 
nationwide network of 5,806 branches. 
This extensive footprint enables the company to efficiently deliver core 
services—loan disbursement, repayment processing, collections, and 
customer verification—across urban and rural areas alike.
• With strong physical coverage, the company is also 
expanding its digital and mobile servicing capabilities to 
enhance accessibility and operational efficiency.
